title: MAT Generator Common Page
summary: Official Derivative MAT Generator Common page reference for common render-state parameters on generator-style MATs, including blend operations, constant-color/alpha blend factors, depth test/write, alpha test, wire frame, cull face, and polygon depth offset.
guidance: Use this article when generator-style material common parameters need more detail than the generic MAT Common page.
Generator common pages include blendop and blendopa controls in addition to source/destination color and alpha factors.
Use constantcol, omconstantcol, constanta, and omconstanta only when a blend mode intentionally depends on constant color or alpha factors.
Depth, alpha, wireframe, cull-face, and polygon-offset guidance matches the shared MAT render-state model.
Choose the filter common-page card instead when the material exposes no generator-specific blend operation controls.
